not_claimed: Rows whose unit has no entry in companion_templets.json keep "templet_key": null; the preview itself is still exact.
No drop chance is recorded: the native call registers pool membership only, so a multi-unit pool must not be read as a uniform distribution.
The shop price and on-sale window of these items are not part of this table.
policy: Read-only. A preview is a shop display link only; it does not authorise granting the companion, and it does not state the pool probabilities.
provenance: Native AddPetPreViewData(item, unit-symbol) registrations. The symbol table is resolved per row: PET_UNIT_ID for pets and RIDING_PET_UNIT_ID for mounts. A single cash item can register a whole pool (random-box items preview up to 24 units), so each item maps to an ordered list rather than one unit.
